text.summary: Apple enters autumn with a fresh chip cycle, a clean quarter, and a stretched multiple.
text.bull_summary: Services momentum and the chip cycle carry the next two quarters.

bull.text: Services revenue keeps double-digit growth on the latest filing.
The announced chip cycle supports an upgrade supercycle into the holidays.

text.bear_summary: The multiple leaves no room for supply stumbles.

bear.text: Panel shortages flagged by suppliers could dent holiday unit volumes.

text.risks_summary: Holiday-quarter execution is the swing factor.

risks.text: The Q4 print lands inside the decision horizon and can reprice the thesis either way.

text.catalysts_summary: Earnings and the chip launch both land inside the horizon.

catalysts.text: Q4 results are scheduled inside the horizon.

text.sentiment_reasons_summary: Chip-cycle news tips the balance positive against supply warnings.

sentiment_reasons.text: The chip announcement outweighs the supplier warnings for now.
